title: Upper ramification jumps of a totally ramified Galois extension of maximal nilpotency class read off from a defining equation
author: Koto Imai
work: Ramification groups of some finite Galois extensions of maximal nilpotency class over local fields of positive characteristic
difficulty_reason: After the ramification theory of Sections 1-2 (Brylinski's theorem, the Abbes-Saito filtration of Kaehler differentials, the author's Lemmas 1.9-1.11, 2.1-2.5, 3.1-3.2 and Propositions 3.4-3.5) is supplied, the counted theorem still requires an argument specific to this paper. The upper jumps r_j of a totally ramified extension of maximal nilpotency class must be extracted from a defining equation: the proof reduces to j=n, compares the two competing quantities through the graded pieces of Omega^1_{L/k} and the isomorphism mu_L, tracks the unique index i realising the maximum, and then has to separate the case -v_L(dc_n) != -v_L(dc''_n) from the delicate equality case, where a congruence modulo p forces j=1, hence m_a=m_1 and m_j=jm_a, and a final non-vanishing computation in Gr_{m_n} Omega^1_{L/k} closes the theorem. Non-abelian ramification in equal characteristic p with an explicit defining equation is research-level local field theory, not a qualifying-exam computation.
